title: Gaps and Islands reference solution
answer: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, order_date::date AS order_day FROM orders), islands AS (SELECT customer_id, order_day, order_day - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_day))::int AS grp FROM days) SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_day) AS start_day, MAX(order_day) AS end_day, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_days FROM islands GROUP BY customer_id, grp ORDER BY customer_id, start_day;
